held_one_reader.r3_why: Real: the subject and verb do not match, and she voiced it.

held_one_reader.amal_said: Do you remember the word for together؟
held_one_reader.why: He meant 'together' (sheet 'together | Ma3 ba3ad') but said بعدين (later). Amal asked for the word for together and he said مع بعض. بعدين may be the engine mishearing ma3 ba3ad, so low.
held_one_reader.r3_why: She asked for 'together' right after his بعدين, which fits him reaching for ma3 ba3ad. Kept low because it may be the engine.

held_one_reader.amal_said: لا، if ... كل هدول الأشياء، وا-- ... مناح.
held_one_reader.why: The plural adjective for أشياء is mnaa7. Amal said لا, started the sentence again and finished it with مناح. The engine wrote إمنا (likely mnee7/a).
held_one_reader.r3_why: Voiced: she said لا and finished the sentence with the plural adjective.

held_one_reader.medi_said: اللي بقالت، uh، I get wrong. I got wrong. قلاتت.
held_one_reader.chat: illi ana ba8lat fiha, u el-grammar illi ba8la6 fiyyo
held_one_reader.why: ba8lat takes fi + an ending (ba8lat fiha). He left the preposition out, and Amal recast بغلط فيها. His follow-up بقالت في (56:26) still had no ending. The q for gh is pronunciation (S4) and is not counted.
held_one_reader.r3_why: Real recast. I anchored it on his first try (56:18) before her 56:23 recast. Filed as D2 (the verb needs fi), with the ending as the second part.

held_one_reader.chat: ana laazem a3malo sehel aktar ilek
held_one_reader.why: aktar goes after the adjective (sehel aktar, her chat). Amal let it pass.
held_one_reader.english: I have to make it easier for you.
held_one_reader.r3_why: Real word-order slip that she let pass. Same pattern as D23.
